text:
I’m passionate about building clear, effective content and I’m a hard-working freelancer who enjoys turning complex topics into copy that feels precise, trustworthy, and easy to understand.

I’d be glad to support your new website with German copy that reflects your positioning as a recruitment partner for cybersecurity, risk management, data science, and ESG. Because your audience is looking for expertise and confidence, I would focus on writing copy that is professional, concise, and aligned with the needs of Fach- und Führungskräfte. I also understand the importance of SEO-friendly content, especially for a website launch, and can help shape text that is both readable and discoverable.

Alongside my writing mindset, I bring extensive experience in machine learning and NLP, which has trained me to work carefully with language, structure, and meaning. In a past project, I built a contract clause search assistant for the legal industry using Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI. It answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. That project improved clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes and achieved a faithfulness score of 0.91 on a lawyer-written test set. While that work was technical, it reflects the same attention to clarity, accuracy, and user intent that strong website copy requires.

I’m comfortable working with nuanced subject matter and translating it into language that feels natural in German. I would be happy to collaborate on homepage text, service pages, and any supporting website content you need for the launch. My goal would be to help your firm present a polished, credible digital presence that speaks directly to both candidates and clients.

If helpful, I can also adapt the tone to be more executive, more approachable, or more conversion-focused depending on your target audience. 

What tone do you want the website copy to have: more corporate and authoritative, or more approachable and modern?
